recognize_zh: 滿視野的顆粒球系細胞從早幼粒到帶狀核都有，許多嗜中性球顆粒稀少、核形不規則或分葉不良，缺乏明顯嗜鹼性球增多，是 BCR-ABL1 陰性 aCML 常見的發育不良顆粒球增生。
features: Hypercellular granulocytic proliferation with all stages of maturation
Numerous myelocytes and metamyelocytes with pale, hypogranular cytoplasm
Irregular, bizarre or hyposegmented neutrophil nuclei (dysgranulopoiesis)
Occasional promyelocytes with azurophilic granules; blasts not increased
Scattered erythroid precursors; basophils not conspicuous
describe_en: Aspirate smear (likely bone marrow) is hypercellular and dominated by granulocytic precursors spanning promyelocytes to band and segmented forms. Many maturing neutrophils show hypogranular cytoplasm and irregular or abnormally segmented nuclei, indicating dysgranulopoiesis. Blasts are not increased in this field, and basophils and monocytes are not prominent. Findings are consistent with a myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm such as atypical chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR-ABL1-negative, pending molecular exclusion of BCR-ABL1 and assessment of CSF3R/SETBP1 status.

ddx.vs: CML features a myelocyte bulge with basophilia and eosinophilia and minimal dysplasia, confirmed by t(9;22)/BCR-ABL1.
CNL consists mainly of mature segmented neutrophils with toxic granulation and lacks dysgranulopoiesis.
MDS is usually cytopenic with increased blasts rather than a leukocytosis with abundant maturing granulocytes.
